case_title.quote: CHOTKAU v. STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH

number_of_accused.quote: the sole accused has come up with the above appeals

accused_occupation.correct_value: Labourer (brothers are labourers per PW-2; accused's own occupation not directly stated)
accused_occupation.quote: All the three of them are engaged in the occupation of labourers.
accused_occupation.reason: Judgment indicates his brothers are labourers; the accused's own occupation is not expressly stated, so 'Not stated' is slightly incomplete.

accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: the appellant is so poor that he could not afford to engage a lawyer

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Not related as niece of accused; she was the niece of the complainant Kishun Bahadur (accused was a fellow villager)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: the appellant herein took his niece aged about 6 years
accused_victim_relationship.reason: 'His' refers to the complainant Kishun Bahadur, not the accused.

offence_category.quote: Convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 302 and 376
offence_category.reason: Charges were murder and rape; only murder listed.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 302 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code

evidence_type.quote: the prosecution of the appellant is based on circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial, last seen, plus medical documents.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: it is one of the rarest of rare cases where a six year old girl had been raped and murdered

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Not discussed as sentencing mitigation; the Court noted the appellant's poverty and lack of lawyer
mitigating_circumstances.quote: the appellant is so poor that he could not afford to engage a lawyer
mitigating_circumstances.reason: 'None noted' ignores poverty remark, though that is not framed as mitigation.

trial_court_outcome.quote: the Sessions Court convicted the appellant for the offences punishable under Sections 302 and 376 of the IPC and awarded death penalty

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence

final_outcome.quote: the appeals are allowed and the conviction and penalty are set aside

offence_finally_established.quote: not convinced that the guilt of the appellant stood established beyond reasonable doubt

imprisonment_type.quote: The appellant shall be released forthwith

neutral_facts.correct_value: Should describe the girl as the complainant's niece; the post-mortem smear report found no spermatozoa; the accused's absence from home was alleged
neutral_facts.quote: the appellant herein took his niece aged about 6 years
neutral_facts.reason: Wrongly says niece of the accused; also 'no positive finding recorded' is imprecise; also 'two villagers' ok.

physical_harm.quote: Blood was coming out of her urinal track, her clothes had torn up and she had died.

motive.reason: No motive stated beyond alleged abnormal sexual urge by lower courts.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: No prosecution evidence accepted as reliable; the Court found the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 untrustworthy and relied on the failure of the prosecution to conduct medical examination, forensic reports and FIR delay
key_evidence_accepted.quote: The failure of the prosecution in this case to subject the appellant to medical examination is certainly fatal
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Broadly right; 'absence of examination' is a gap rather than evidence accepted.

witness_credibility.quote: These contradictions make the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 completely untrustworthy.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Prosecution relied on the appellant absconding/leaving the field; Court found PWs 1-3 untrustworthy
post_offence_conduct.reason: Broadly right, but the Court did not specifically address absconding evidence.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 08.03.2012; High Court judgment 18.04.2016; SC 28.09.2022; trial judgment date not stated

legal_representation.quote: S. Nagamuthu, Sr. Adv., Ms. Shivani Misra

investigation_status.quote: The Court of the CJM, Shravasti, received the copy of the FIR on 13.03.2012

procedural_irregularity.quote: delay of 5 days in transmitting the FIR to the jurisdictional court

appeal_history.quote: the appeals are allowed and the conviction and penalty are set aside

prosecution_argument.quote: there are no reasons for PWs 1 to 3 to implicate the appellant

defence_argument.quote: the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 is untrustworthy

legal_principle_applied.quote: Failure of the prosecution to subject the appellant to medical examination is certainly fatal

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda ... Rajendra Pralhadrao Wasnik

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentence imposed; conviction set aside.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: None adopted by the Supreme Court.

other_sentence_order.quote: The appellant shall be released forthwith if not wanted in connection with any other case.
